verdict.rationale: Navan publishes an Expense API reference, but its own developer-portal evidence says the reference is static curl/Node examples, there is no OpenAPI or Swagger document, production is the only base URL, and access is partner-gated. Nothing shows an interactive explorer or in-browser runnable examples. Static code snippets are an adjacent feature, not the story's capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
